faqs.q: What is Royal Tech Innovation LMS?
faqs.a: Royal Tech Innovation LMS is a Coursera-style course marketplace. Browse 100+ career courses across 12 domains, enroll online, learn at your pace, complete projects, and earn shareable certificates — all in one platform.

faqs.q: How do I enroll in a course?
faqs.a: Open any course page, review the syllabus and price, then click Enroll or Add to cart. After checkout, the course unlocks instantly in My Learning so you can start watching lessons right away.

faqs.q: Are courses self-paced or live?
faqs.a: Most courses are fully self-paced with 24/7 access. Selected paths also include live workshops and office hours so you can ask instructors questions in real time.

faqs.q: Will I get a certificate?
faqs.a: Yes. When you complete required modules, quizzes, and assessments, you receive a shareable Royal Tech certificate you can add to LinkedIn, your resume, or your portfolio.

faqs.q: What skills and domains can I learn?
faqs.a: AI, Data Science, Cloud, Software Development, Cybersecurity, Business & Innovation, Digital Marketing, Finance & FinTech, Mobile Development, Blockchain & Web3, Project Management, and Graphic Design.

faqs.q: What is Royal Tech Plus?
faqs.a: Royal Tech Plus is our unlimited learning plan — monthly or annual. Get catalog-wide access, certificates after your trial, and new course drops as they launch. Cancel monthly anytime.

faqs.q: Can my company train employees here?
faqs.a: Yes. Royal Tech for Teams includes seat management, progress analytics, and shared catalog access so L&D leaders can upskill 10–125 employees on one platform.

faqs.q: Do I need coding experience?
faqs.a: Not for every course. AI Essentials, Digital Marketing, UI/UX, and many beginner paths need no coding. Data, ML, Full-Stack, and DevOps paths recommend basic programming comfort.

faqs.q: How long do I keep access after purchase?
faqs.a: Individual course purchases include lifetime access to the enrolled course content. Plus subscriptions stay active while your plan is billed.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: We support secure online checkout for individual courses and subscription plans. Corporate invoices and team billing are available for Royal Tech for Teams.

faqs.q: Is there a refund policy?
faqs.a: Yes. Eligible plans include a money-back window (for example, 14 days on annual Plus). Refund terms depend on the product you purchased — see Refund Policy for full details.

faqs.q: Can I learn from outside India?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Royal Tech Innovation LMS is built for global learners — enroll online, learn from any device, and earn certificates from anywhere with internet access.

faqs.q: Where do I track progress and certificates?
faqs.a: Everything lives in My Learning — enrolled courses, module progress, assessments, live sessions, and certificates you can download or share.

faqs.q: How do I get help if I’m stuck?
faqs.a: Use Contact Us, email, or WhatsApp for support. Selected courses also include Q&A and live office hours. Visit /faq for the full help center.

faqs.q: How many courses are available right now?
faqs.a: Royal Tech Innovation LMS currently lists 100+ marketplace courses across 12 domains — AI, data, cloud, software, cybersecurity, marketing, FinTech, mobile, Web3, project management, design, and business innovation.

faqs.q: Can I preview a course before buying?
faqs.a: Yes. Each course page shows the syllabus overview, learning outcomes, duration, level, instructor, ratings, and pricing so you can decide before you enroll.

faqs.q: What happens after I complete a course?
faqs.a: Your progress is marked complete in My Learning, and when assessments are passed you can unlock your certificate to download or share.

faqs.q: Can I switch from a single course to Royal Tech Plus later?
faqs.a: Yes. Start with one course anytime, then upgrade to Royal Tech Plus monthly or annual whenever you want unlimited catalog access.

faqs.q: Are live workshops recorded?
faqs.a: Yes. For enrolled learners, recordings of eligible live sessions are typically available after the workshop so you can revise later.

faqs.q: Do beginner courses include projects?
faqs.a: Most beginner paths include guided exercises or mini projects. Intermediate and advanced courses usually include portfolio-ready projects.

faqs.q: How do team seats work for companies?
faqs.a: With Royal Tech for Teams, admins invite employees by seat, assign learning paths, and track completion analytics from one dashboard.

faqs.q: Can I use Royal Tech on mobile?
faqs.a: Yes. The LMS works on desktops, tablets, and mobile browsers so you can learn on the go.

faqs.q: Do certificates expire?
faqs.a: Completion certificates remain available in your account after you earn them. Keep a downloaded copy for your records and LinkedIn profile.

faqs.q: What if a course is too advanced for me?
faqs.a: Use the level filter (Beginner / Intermediate / Advanced) on course pages and domain catalogs. Many domains include an essentials course designed as a safe starting point.

faqs.q: Is there student or career support?
faqs.a: Yes. Contact support for enrollment help, and use My Learning resources, course Q&A, and selected live office hours for learning guidance.

faqs.q: Can I gift a course to someone?
faqs.a: Individual course purchases are tied to the enrolled learner account. For gifting or team access, contact support or use Royal Tech for Teams seat invites.

faqs.q: How often are new courses added?
faqs.a: New courses and Specializations are added regularly. Subscribe to the newsletter to get launch updates first.

faqs.q: Do you offer assessments and quizzes?
faqs.a: Yes. Most courses include module quizzes and end-of-course assessments to verify learning before certificate unlock.

faqs.q: What languages are courses taught in?
faqs.a: Primary course language is English. Captions or localized materials may be added on selected courses over time.

faqs.q: How do I reset my password or recover my account?
faqs.a: Use the account login recovery / reset password flow. If you still need help, contact support with your registered email.
